texts.name: Vehr
texts.biography: Vehr earned her moniker, Goldtooth, long before replacing her worn-out fangs with ones of pure metal. To this day, her teeth remain the primary tool of her trade, as she possesses the remarkable talent to discern a rock's composition simply by biting into it. Being so blessed, she does not waste time on trifles; her expertise lies in finding rich gold veins.

specialty.name: +350 Gold
specialty.description: Increases kingdom's income by 350 gold per day.
